A new attempt proceeds through chest looting, wood/crafting, boating, ruined portal and nether entry. Settings samples and an explicit Game paused (#3) overlay are visible later. The 1 fps proxy has 1 s transition uncertainty and may miss short menus. Do not treat this cross-attempt -6.45 s difference as a same-run edit measurement; segment attempts and establish GUI-clock identity first.

Two brief options visits total approximately 0.5-1.5 s, substantially below the -4.3167 s deficit. A further approximately 5.75-6.25 s displays an extremely narrow game window with eye-of-ender imagery. Ordinary pause/capture interruption is visible, but the obscured game state prevents exact closure.

Three pause/options visits, including an in-game feedback-link confirmation dialog, span combined transition bounds 2.75-4.25 s, compatible with the 3.167 s deficit. The dialog is observed in-game; no external link was opened by this review.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
